---
name: letter-swap
description: "Use this skill to swap all instances of the letter 'e' for the letter 'd' in a chapter. Use when you want to perform a simple letter substitution across the text."
---

1. First identify all instances of the letter 'e' in the chapter.
2. Create a report with all instances of 'e' and their positions in the text.
3. Replace each instance of 'e' with the letter 'd'.
